features.quote: It stops on: max steps, wall-clock timeout, self-abort (give-up lexicon), or client error.
Self-abort ends the loop early. Once the model says "I give up," continuing wastes budget
features.justification_quote: continuing wastes budget and would only add more give-up text

features.quote: we only end the loop on a *strong* give-up... so a metaphorical "I give up trying this approach" does not prematurely halt
features.justification_quote: does not prematurely halt a productive session

features.quote: If `patched_cost_cap_usd` is set and exceeded, force FAIL regardless.
Online trigger detection runs every turn so we can record `first_meltdown_step`
features.justification_quote: severity latency... without waiting for the judge
